points.description: Names three parameters that affect MRR in ultrasonic machining, from: frequency of vibration, amplitude of vibration, abrasive slurry concentration, slurry particle (grit) diameter. Clear synonyms are accepted, such as vibration frequency, vibration amplitude, grit or abrasive concentration, and grain or grit size. Any three of the four count, and a fourth correct item is also fine.
points.partial_credit: 1 mark for one or two correct parameters from the list

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming any three of the four model-answer parameters, in any wording or with clear synonyms. Give 1 mark for one or two correct parameters, or for an answer on the right track that is vague, such as naming a general cause without the parameter itself. Give 0 for no correct parameter or only unrelated factors. Do not penalise extra remarks unless they contradict the parameters named.
